summary: GPB Holdings II, LP filed an 8-K reporting a quarterly status update in its ongoing federal receivership. The registrant sold substantially all assets and operates under a U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of New York receivership order. The receiver filed the Q1 2026 status report, which is incorporated by reference. The company has adopted a modified reporting approach, filing quarterly receiver reports on Form 8-K instead of regular 10-K/10-Q filings. Epiq Corporate Restructuring is the claims agent. Watch for developments on claims resolution, potential distributions, or a wind-down plan in this court-supervised liquidation.
